items.headline: Cyclone alert issued for the Eastern Coast
items.summary: Strong winds and heavy rain are possible along coastal districts over the next 48 hours.

items.headline: Heavy rainfall in Assam, rivers above danger level
items.summary: Residents near river banks are advised to monitor local updates and avoid flooded roads.

items.headline: Landslide risk increased in Uttarakhand
items.summary: Recent rainfall has increased the possibility of slope instability in vulnerable areas.

items.headline: Flood watch continues for low-lying delta districts
items.summary: Keep emergency supplies accessible and follow instructions from local officials.

items.headline: Monsoon showers expected across central India
items.summary: Scattered showers are forecast, with locally heavy rain possible in some districts.
